Dear all,

I am looking for some suggestions : I have a graph with multiple line plots, where x axis represent the coordinates of genes on a human chromosome. In addition to the line plots, I would like add additional information about what is on the chromosome (eg. position of the gene - the gene can be shown as a tile; or position of mutations - these can be shown as dots).

Please could you suggest an effective way to plot other graphs (tiles, dots) exactly under the multiple line plots (in a very precise manner). thanks a lot,

Bogdan
